decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (940-PE-07-XX-DR-E-0800, 140940/SK101, 940-PE-XX-ZZ-DR-A-9000, 940-PE-07-ZZ-DR-A-3101, 940-PE-07-00-DR-A-1201, 940-PE-07-01-DR-A-1202, 940-PE-01-ZZ-DR-A-9001 received 03/06/2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The development hereby permitted and other associated structures shall be removed from the site within three years of the date of this permission. Within three months of removal [or in the first available planting season thereafter] following removal of the mobile classrooms, the land shall be reinstated to grass and tarmac as shown on the Council's 2013 aerial photograph of the site or to such other surfacing as may first be submitted to, and thereafter approved in writing by, the local planning authority.
description: Erection of two double storey temporary buildings each consisting of two classrooms with associated toilets and stores
